governance_note: This manifest separates 5 deterministic primary gate criteria from 4 supporting audit criteria, resolving the 9-vs-5 schema inconsistency present in earlier versions.

primary_gate.description: These 5 boolean criteria must ALL be TRUE for PHYSICAL_INDEPENDENCE = ESTABLISHED. Any FALSE returns overall_independence = FALSE.

different_building.description: MAMUL DEPO stamping press shop with hydraulic presses and high-bay roof, completely distinct from Central 01 loading dock.

independent_session.description: Independent capture session with live forklift in painted floor aisle and machine operators.

independent_camera.description: IPC overhead CCTV watermark observed; distinct from Central 01 CCTV Door 4.1. Exact hardware model and sensor format remain NOT_AVAILABLE.

independent_raw_provenance.description: Raw video 0_te11.mp4 authenticated via SHA-256 (170a97c8...) on disk. Original camera export certificate remains NOT_AVAILABLE.

frame_overlap_absent.description: Minimum Hamming distance of 97 vs Central 01 keyframes (rejection threshold <= 15). Frame overlap status CLEAR.

primary_gate.evaluation_rule: ALL primary_gate criteria must be TRUE. No inferred or partial evidence upgrades any criterion to TRUE.

supporting_audit.description: These 4 criteria do not block the primary gate but must be documented. VERIFIED criteria are enforced by protocol; others require physical evidence.

independent_mounting_geometry.description: Camera height, pitch, roll, and optics differ from Central 01. Requires physical measurement.

independent_lighting_environment.description: Illumination conditions (lux, spectrum, fixture type) are physically distinct. Requires optical measurement.

zero_tuning_on_evaluation_footage.description: Zero parameter adaptation enforced by blind protocol and run_exp_333_01.py execution gate.

synthetic_substitution_rejected.description: Synthetic transformations of Central 01 footage (resize, crop, blur, warp, AI-generation) are explicitly rejected.

current_blocker: NONE (All 5 primary gate criteria established with documented limitations)
prohibited_inference_rules: PLANNED camera specifications must never be treated as MEASURED evidence.
Perceptual similarity to non-Central-01 footage does not establish independence.
A passing Central 01 exclusion check alone does not establish physical independence.
Frame-overlap CLEAR status requires physical raw footage to be present on disk.

data_volume_limitation.rule: Results from this clip must NOT be extrapolated as universal warehouse generalization.
